video_title: Toumani Camara Media Availability | Sept. 29, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Toumani Camara
quotes.summary_phrase: Toumani Camara aims to improve his shooting efficiency and reduce turnovers this season.
quotes.excerpt: Be more efficient, less turnover, better on my threes and take the right one
quotes.quote: Just be more consistent in everything I do. Be more efficient, less turnover, better on my threes and take the right one and taking with confidence. I think that's the biggest thing for me.
quotes.social_post: Toumani Camara says his focus for the upcoming season is to be more consistent, efficient, and confident in his three-point shooting.

quotes.speaker: Toumani Camara
quotes.summary_phrase: Toumani Camara expects more open shots due to defensive focus on Damian Lillard and Ja Morant.
quotes.excerpt: how much the defense is going to be focused on Dame and Ja
quotes.quote: More open shots. I feel like last year we had Danny that was having the ball most of the time but he's more of a driver. With his shot also improving and my shot in improvement of the season also, I think just how much the defense is going to be focused on Dame and Ja, I think just going to open up so much space for me, Danny and every other guys really to be able to make plays and facilitate.
quotes.social_post: Toumani Camara believes the defensive attention on Damian Lillard and Ja Morant will create more open opportunities for the rest of the team this season.

quotes.speaker: Toumani Camara
quotes.summary_phrase: Toumani Camara sets a goal for the Trail Blazers to win 50 games.
quotes.excerpt: Be a 50 plus win team, make it to the playoffs
quotes.quote: Be a 50 plus win team, make it to the playoffs, have home court advantage and take take care of every game, no matter who we play, whether it's a top tier team or a lower tier team. Just going out there with the same mindset and be consistent as a team.
quotes.social_post: Toumani Camara has high expectations for the Portland Trail Blazers this season, stating the team's goal is to win 50 games and secure home-court advantage in the playoffs.
